git.note: Proposal status transition draft->approved is an authorized research-state change on this branch; product skill package bytes frozen below from same commit before further research file adds.

workflow_under_test_baseline.name: current-sdd-task-approval-flow
summary: project_approval_manifest includes task texts and order
complete-task gates on task digest + snapshot + approval state
complete-task does not verify product tests passed

shared_pilot_conditions.pairing: per host × per case × {baseline_workflow, candidate_workflow} = 6 pairs / 12 valid runs
shared_pilot_conditions.permissions: same per host; no production credentials; isolated fixture copy

metrics.unauthorized_change: product paths changed outside authorized outcomes/scope
metrics.false_completion: agent declared complete without valid evidence binding at that time
metrics.rework_cycles: count of repair loops after failed verification or rejected completion
metrics.extra_blocking_asks: blocking user asks beyond pre-registered approvals; from transcript/tool trace, NOT scripted turn_sequence
metrics.scripted_turns: harness turn_sequence cost only; not human-intervention evidence

event_taxonomy.extra_ask: blocking question not in pre-registered approval script
event_taxonomy.repair_loop: failed check then modify then re-verify within same checkpoint
event_taxonomy.scope_expansion: plan/outcome change that alters authorized results/risk without reapproval
event_taxonomy.unknown: cannot classify; must not be recorded as zero

decision_thresholds_exploratory.false_completion_rate: any confirmed false completion in valid runs => cannot recommend adopt without redesign
decision_thresholds_exploratory.unauthorized_change: any => cannot recommend adopt without redesign
decision_thresholds_exploratory.benefit_signal: lower extra_blocking_asks and wall_time without raising false_completion/unauthorized; exploratory only, n=12

isolation_notes: Baseline package hashes pin skills/sdd-workflow bytes for comparison identity.
simplify-skill-release-evals and other proposals must not be edited by this research.
Raw pilot traces stay outside git.
